opportunity_name: Globex Corp 24/7 Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) Retainer & Compromise Assessment
rfp_text: Globex Corporation is soliciting proposals for a 24/7 Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) Emergency Retainer with a guaranteed 2-hour remote SLA and 4-hour on-site SLA. The scope must include a 100-hour prepaid emergency incident pool, an annual Compromise Assessment (CA) sweep across 500 domain endpoints, and Breach & Attack Simulation (BAS) detection testing against our SIEM and EDR setup.
